findings.title: Same unguarded modelSupplier dereference remains in the paged getSubGroupsStream overloads
findings.body: The fix only guards getSubGroupsCount(). The three paged overloads (getSubGroupsStream(search, firstResult, maxResults) at line 256, getSubGroupsStream(firstResult, maxResults) at line 262, and getSubGroupsStream(search, exact, firstResult, maxResults) at line 268) still call modelSupplier.get().getSubGroupsStream(...) without a null check. If the group was deleted concurrently, modelSupplier.get() returns null and these throw the same NullPointerException the PR is meant to fix. Either guard these the same way, or throw a consistent not-found exception.

findings.title: getSubGroupsCount now returns null silently for a deleted group
findings.body: When the backing group no longer exists, getSubGroupsCount() returns null instead of a count or an error. It is declared to return Long, so callers that unbox it (e.g. `long c = group.getSubGroupsCount();`) will hit an NPE at the call site, which only moves the NPE elsewhere. The caller gets no signal that the group vanished. The behaviour is inconsistent with isUpdated(), which throws IllegalStateException("Not found in database") for the same situation. Consider throwing the same exception, or documenting the null contract.

findings.title: Background reader thread is never joined, so the assertion can miss exceptions
findings.body: The reader thread is started at line 139 and never joined. deletedAll is set to true at line 155 and the assertion at line 157 runs immediately. A reader request still in flight when the loop exits can add an exception to caughtExceptions after the assertion has already passed, so the test can pass spuriously. The thread should be joined before asserting.

findings.title: Exception during group removal leaves the reader thread spinning forever
findings.body: If group(groupUuid).remove() throws (lines 152-154 are not guarded), execution skips deletedAll.set(true) at line 155. The non-daemon reader thread then loops forever, which keeps the test JVM alive and hangs the build. Wrap the deletion loop in try/finally that sets deletedAll, and consider marking the thread as a daemon.

findings.title: Regression test only covers the brief groups listing, not the path that still NPEs
findings.body: The test exercises groups(...) with briefRepresentation=true, but the NPE fixed in GroupAdapter is reached through subgroup and count access. The test never accesses getSubGroupsCount or the paged getSubGroupsStream overloads concurrently with deletion, so it would not catch the remaining unguarded paths. The method name createMultiDeleteMultiReadMulti is also unclear about what is verified.
